text:
Maya P.: quick sync — we need to lock down lanes for week1 post-launch. primary question: what do we commit to fixing vs what goes into polish? I sketched three lanes: 1) customer-critical regressions (ship this week), 2) p99 / SLA blockers (ship asap, maybe hotpatch), 3) UX polish / nice-to-have (next mini-wave). thoughts?

Sam K.: +1 on lanes. can we fold in customer asks that hit revenue? e.g., ACME embed ordering bug — they escalated.

Jordan R.: ACME ticket is #INC-4342, reproduction confirmed. root cause looks like token truncation in our reranking preproc. estimate 2 dev days + 1 QA day.

Lee H.: p99 latencies spiking for long conversations (seq > 1024). that's causing timeouts for a handful of enterprise customers. I can instrument a quick KV-cache bypass to test; maybe a config toggle for Dedicated customers to reduce batching. ~1.5 dev days.

Rae L.: QA-Bot: regression matrix updated: ACME embed failing on 3% of samples, conversational p99 shows 2.4s->4.8s in worst window.

Maya P.: OK — proposal: commit ACME fix into lane 1 (customer-critical), p99 mitigation into lane 2 (SLA), everything else (small UI awkwardness, prompt wording) to polish lane. If we need to trade, we pull one small polish out.

Sam K.: Agree. Can we add rollout criterion: ACME fix must have acceptance test (repro-case) and smoke on staging + canary 10% before prod?

Jordan R.: yup. I'll write a small e2e test that asserts embedding order and add to ci-smoke.

Lee H.: For p99 mitigation, I'll ship a toggle behind feature flag targeting Dedicated clusters. That lets us ship faster while we iterate on kernel/runtime.

Rae L.: QA-Bot: suggested acceptance checks:
- ACME e2e repro (deterministic) on staging
- p99 regression run < 3.0s for 95th percentile on a 30m window
- no increase in token-level error rate

Maya P.: timeline ask: can we get ACME fix + staging smoke by EOD Thursday? p99 toggle by Friday midday? If so, we can do a limited canary over Friday afternoon and full rollout Monday morning.

Sam K.: ACME fix ETA: Jordan finishes dev tomorrow afternoon, QA Thurs AM, staging smoke Thurs PM. good.

Jordan R.: pushing a draft PR now: link https://git.redwood/PR/5678 — includes repro and test.

Lee H.: p99 toggle PR will land today, canary config scripted. I'll coordinate with eng-sre for the small capacity bump.

Rae L.: QA-Bot: I'll run the regression suite on staging Thursday 10:00 PST and post results.

Maya P.: Great — owner assignments: Jordan (ACME fix), Lee (p99 toggle/mitigation), Rae (QA + acceptance). Sam will drive the canary criteria and communicate to ACME. I'll update the roadmap card and mark scope committed for week1.

Sam K.: I'll draft the customer note after canary is green.

Jordan R.: merged PR, CI passing, added test.

Lee H.: p99 toggle deployed to staging behind flag. perf looks improved in quick runs. leveling up to canary after QA signoff.

Rae L.: QA run complete: ACME repro fixed, p99 window shows reduction to 2.6s median, 95th at 2.9s. No regressions detected in other workloads.

Maya P.: Excellent work team. Final decision: ship ACME fix + p99 toggle in canary Friday 20% for 6 hours, then 50% overnight if stable, full Monday. Ship polish backlog to follow-up wave unless any urgent customer escalations arise. I'll post the updated card and close this thread. :rocket:
